title: Water-Chamber Care Labor on Returned PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Water-Chamber Care Labor on Returned PAP Therapy Equipment

**Rule.** When a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit comes back to Summit Ridge on a completed return pickup request, the labor booked on its return inspection depends on whether the heated humidifier went into use:

- a device furnished with a humidifier to a patient whose active enrollment in the **PAP Supply Replenishment Program** shows the humidifier in use adds **2 labor units** to dry and descale the water chamber;
- a device furnished with a humidifier to a patient whose supply enrollment does not show it in use adds **1 labor unit**;
- a device without a humidifier adds none.

**Where the facts are read.** Whether a humidifier was furnished is read from the PAP Therapy Equipment device record (humidifier included or not). Whether the humidifier is in use is read from the patient's PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment that is in status active — its humidifier-in-use indicator. A patient with no active enrollment has no enrollment showing the humidifier in use. Labor units are 15-minute units.

## Combinations

| Humidifier furnished with the device | Active supply enrollment shows the humidifier in use | Labor units added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 2 |
| yes | no, or no active enrollment | 1 |
| no | yes | 0 |
| no | no, or no active enrollment | 0 |

**Case (hypothetical).** An Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) furnished with a humidifier is returned by a patient whose PAP Supply Replenishment Program enrollment is on hold rather than active. No active enrollment shows the humidifier in use, so 1 labor unit is added.
